query: What signals in a travel-expense description predict whether it will be declined?

per_column.name: has_travel_keyword
per_column.rationale: Binary interpretable flag with well-separated groups (359/141) that can be segmented against decline rate; captures a content signal from the description.

per_column.name: has_auto_generated_language
per_column.rationale: Interpretable binary indicator of boilerplate/auto-generated text, a plausible associational signal for declines with a decent split (349/151).

per_column.name: has_expense_keyword
per_column.rationale: Interpretable keyword flag; split is skewed (435/65) but the minority group is large enough to compare decline rates.

per_column.name: has_equipment_keyword
per_column.rationale: Interpretable flag distinguishing equipment-related descriptions (440/60), a meaningful category to segment against the focus.

per_column.name: is_travel_category
per_column.rationale: Clear categorical segmentation (354/146) directly relevant to travel-expense declines; groupable and comparable.

per_column.name: desc_word_count
per_column.rationale: Interpretable ordinal scale of description length concentrated in 3-9 words; can be binned and compared, though borderline mechanical it remains human-readable.

per_column.name: amount_tier
per_column.rationale: Excellent interpretable segmentation (low/medium/high) with well-populated categories, ideal for comparing decline rates by spend level.

per_column.name: travel_expense_signal
per_column.rationale: Distribution (359/141) is identical to has_travel_keyword, indicating it duplicates that flag rather than adding a distinct relationship.

judge.rationale: As a set, these columns provide several interpretable, well-separated segmentations (amount_tier, is_travel_category, and the keyword/auto-generated flags) that a human can group on and compare against decline rates, satisfying the EDA claim. Weaknesses: travel_expense_signal appears to duplicate has_travel_keyword, and several columns are thematically overlapping travel/keyword flags rather than diverse external axes; desc_word_count is somewhat mechanical. No column is opaque or near-constant, but the redundancy and clustering around a single theme cap the informativeness.
